hero.title: Turn your land and your wishes into a structured house project
hero.subtitle: Enter land area, house dimensions, rooms and style — archAi turns them into precise, validated project data. Plans, a 3D preview and a preliminary estimate come next.

ai.body: Describe your request in your own words — AI drafts a configuration proposal, you review and confirm it.

input.title: Describe the project
input.subtitle: Write whatever you know about the land, the house, floors, rooms and extras. AI only proposes — what gets saved is your call.
input.label: Your request
input.hint: Write in Uzbek, Russian or English. Concrete numbers (sotix, metres, floors, room counts) make the result better.
input.placeholder: A 2-storey modern house with 4 rooms on 6 sotix, with a garage and a terrace
input.example: A 2-storey modern house with 4 rooms on 6 sotix, with a garage and a terrace. Living room, kitchen and bathroom on the ground floor.
input.note: Nothing is saved automatically — you see the proposal first.
input.pendingLive: AI is reading your request. This can take a few seconds.
input.readyLive: The proposal is ready. Please review it.

review.title: AI proposal
review.subtitle: This is a proposal, not a project yet. Edit the name and description, then confirm.
review.descriptionHint: Optional. You can change it at any time.
review.descriptionPlaceholder: A short note about this project
review.assumptionsBody: Things the text did not state outright and the AI filled in. Please check them.
review.unmappableBody: These cannot be stored as project data yet — they will not be saved. Discuss them separately with your builder or architect.
review.applyFailed: The project could not be saved
review.createdBody: The project was created but the configuration was not saved. Open it and set it up manually.
review.applyHint: On confirmation the project is created and the proposed configuration is saved.
review.applyBlocked: The configuration has errors, so it cannot be saved as it is.
review.applyDropped: Opening it in edit mode drops the failing part ({blocks}) and keeps the rest.
review.strategyEmpty: The request did not state a layout style.

AI_NOT_CONFIGURED.title: AI is not connected yet

AI_PROVIDER_ERROR.title: AI service error

AI_REFUSED.title: AI declined to answer
AI_REFUSED.body: Rephrase it as a house request: land area, house dimensions, floors and rooms.

AI_INVALID_OUTPUT.title: The answer could not be read

about.metaDescription: archAi turns your plot and requirements into a structured home project. Our mission and approach.
about.title: Making home planning accessible
about.subtitle: archAi turns a complex planning process into simple, clear steps.
about.mission: Everyone should be able to picture their home clearly before building. We turn plot, dimensions and requirements into a structured, validated project — without jargon or guesswork.
about.howBody: You enter the plot area, house dimensions, rooms and style. archAi validates it instantly, produces a 2D plan and a rough estimate. Everything is kept in one place.
about.honesty: archAi gives a rough estimate and concept — it is not official construction documentation. Confirm the project with a licensed professional before starting work.
about.contactBody: Have a question or suggestion? Write to us — no fake forms, just direct email.
